item.text: I want to acknowledge that your idea about streamlining the client onboarding process was not credited during today’s meeting. I’m sorry for the oversight; you deserved recognition for your contribution. I will follow up with the team to clarify that the proposal originated with you, update the meeting notes, and make sure your role is acknowledged in the next project discussion. I’ll also be more careful to attribute ideas accurately in future meetings.
